Name: Place Furniture Outside (Furniture Anywhere Redux)
Author: glymr
Description:
Installing this mod will allow you to place furniture outside and in other locations where it's normally not allowed. Furniture types included are: lamps, fish tanks, couches, armchairs, rugs, floor dividers, bookcases, dressers, TVs, and fireplaces. Content Patcher and Alternative Textures mods that change the look of furniture will still work. I believe I have included all furniture that I can (including the new furniture added with 1.6!) but if I missed anything, please leave me a comment and let me know!

NOT included are beds, mini-fridges, or anything that must be hung on the wall (windows or paintings). If you would like to place beds and mini-fridges in non-standard locations, look up [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url].

The latest version under the Files tab is the 1.6 version. If you want the 1.5 Legacy version, check the "Optional Files" section under the
Files tab above.

If you like this mod, it would make me very happy if you would endorse it. <3  Thank you!
